verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers incident creation, acknowledgment, escalation policies, on-call scheduling, and status pages, but contains no mention of MTTA/MTTR trend reporting, incident load analytics, or on-call health dashboards that would let a leader track improvement over time. This is a fair capability to expect from an incident/on-call platform, but no evidence shows it exists. Missing for 10: MTTA/MTTR trend metrics, incident load/volume analytics, on-call health/burnout reporting, any historical dashboard or exportable reliability report.
